mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_INDICATOR_DEFINITION (ID, CODE, NAME, DATA_TYPE, SOURCE_TYPE, PERSON_FIELD, UNIT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{dataType}, #{sourceType}, #{personField}, #{unit}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, CODE, NAME, DATA_TYPE, SOURCE_TYPE, PERSON_FIELD, UNIT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_INDICATOR_DEFINITION WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT ID, CODE, NAME, DATA_TYPE, SOURCE_TYPE, PERSON_FIELD, UNIT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_INDICATOR_DEFINITION WHERE CODE = #{code}
SELECT ID, CODE, NAME, DATA_TYPE, SOURCE_TYPE, PERSON_FIELD, UNIT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_INDICATOR_DEFINITION WHERE STATUS = 1 ORDER BY CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_INDICATOR_DEFINITION SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_INDICATOR_OPTION (ID, INDICATOR_ID, OPTION_CODE, OPTION_LABEL, SORT_NO, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{indicatorId}, #{code}, #{label}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, INDICATOR_ID, OPTION_CODE AS CODE, OPTION_LABEL AS LABEL, SORT_NO, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_INDICATOR_OPTION WHERE INDICATOR_ID = #{indicatorId} AND OPTION_CODE = #{code}

SELECT ID, INDICATOR_ID, OPTION_CODE AS CODE, OPTION_LABEL AS LABEL, SORT_NO, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_INDICATOR_OPTION WHERE INDICATOR_ID = #{indicatorId} AND STATUS = 1 ORDER BY SORT_NO, OPTION_CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_INDICATOR_OPTION SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, PERSON_ID, INDICATOR_ID, STRING_VALUE, NUMBER_VALUE, DATE_VALUE, BOOLEAN_VALUE, OPTION_CODE, PERIOD_START, PERIOD_END, SOURCE_TYPE, IMPORT_BATCH_NO, SOURCE_UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_PERSON_INDICATOR WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND INDICATOR_ID = #{indicatorId}

SELECT ID, PERSON_ID, INDICATOR_ID, STRING_VALUE, NUMBER_VALUE, DATE_VALUE, BOOLEAN_VALUE, OPTION_CODE, PERIOD_START, PERIOD_END, SOURCE_TYPE, IMPORT_BATCH_NO, SOURCE_UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_PERSON_INDICATOR WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} ORDER BY INDICATOR_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_PERSON_INDICATOR (ID, PERSON_ID, INDICATOR_ID, STRING_VALUE, NUMBER_VALUE, DATE_VALUE, BOOLEAN_VALUE, OPTION_CODE, PERIOD_START, PERIOD_END, SOURCE_TYPE, IMPORT_BATCH_NO, SOURCE_UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{personId}, #{indicatorId}, #{stringValue}, #{numberValue}, #{dateValue}, #{booleanValue}, #{optionCode}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{sourceType}, #{importBatchNo}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
